decisions.reason: The air quality Bricklet is a sensor module built on the firm's core in-house electronics, firmware and API-generation knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving it within the building-block system.
The Analog In Bricklet 3.0 is a new hardware generation of an established module, sitting squarely within existing knowledge and fitting the firm's practice of iterative hardware updates.
The CAN bus interface extends the firm's connectivity know-how and serves its automation and industrial customers, so in-house development capability supports keeping and refining it.
The CO2 sensor module is closely related to the firm's other environmental sensor Bricklets, letting it absorb feedback and keep the product within its modular platform.
